description: Finance Committee will appoint its Chair and Vice-Chair.
Appointments are for the remainder of 2024.
Councillor Donauer was the previous Chair.

chips.text: Five councillors appointed to Finance Committee.

description: Committee recommends allocating HAF interest to Affordable Housing Reserve.
Allocating HAF interest creates exception to Policy C03-003.
Additional funds are needed for affordable housing demand.

chips.text: Councillor Jeffries questioned how the city covers shortfalls in other federal projects.

description: Sells 127 single-unit lots and one multi-unit parcel in Kensington.
Sales require a 10% deposit and 12 months no interest.

chips.text: Individuals and eligible contractors can purchase Kensington lots.

description: Recommends 5-year grant-in-lieu agreement for Prairieland Park's Sports on Tap.
Formalizes voluntary property tax payments from 2024 to 2028.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois questioned the history of voluntary payments.
Jurisdictional scan found no comparable tax-exempt facilities.
Public inquiries raised Sports on Tap's property tax status.

segments.title: Prairieland Park Sports on Tap Grant-in-Lieu Agreement Introduction
segments.takeaway: Administration introduced a report seeking approval for a five-year grant-in-lieu agreement with Prairieland Park for the Sports on Tap facility.

segments.title: Prairieland Park CEO Presentation
segments.takeaway: Prairieland Park's CEO presented on the proposed five-year grant-in-lieu agreement for Sports on Tap, highlighting the organization's community contributions.

segments.title: Questions for Prairieland Park CEO
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned the Prairieland Park CEO about the history and continuation of voluntary grant-in-lieu payments for Sports on Tap.

segments.title: Questions for Administration on Prairieland Park Agreement
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration about precedents for similar agreements in other municipalities regarding Prairieland Park's tax status.

segments.title: Prairieland Park Grant-in-Lieu Agreement Vote
segments.takeaway: The committee unanimously carried the recommendation to approve the five-year grant-in-lieu agreement with Prairieland Park for the Sports on Tap facility.

segments.title: Housing Accelerator Fund Interest Introduction
segments.takeaway: Administration introduced a report recommending that interest earned on unspent Housing Accelerator Funds be allocated to the affordable housing reserve.

segments.title: Questions for Administration on Housing Accelerator Fund Interest
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration about allocating interest to affordable housing versus general revenue, considering other city needs and inflationary pressures.

segments.title: Debate and Vote on Housing Accelerator Fund Interest Allocation
segments.takeaway: The committee debated the allocation of Housing Accelerator Fund interest, with the initial motion to allocate to affordable housing being defeated.

segments.title: Motion to Allocate Housing Accelerator Fund Interest to General Revenue
segments.takeaway: A motion was made and carried to allocate Housing Accelerator Fund interest to general revenue, with administration to bring back options for its allocation.

description: Riversdale Business Improvement District meeting procedures are now public.
This fulfills a new city bylaw requirement.

chips.text: Councillor Goodwill questioned the delay in Riversdale BID's submission.
Reason for Riversdale BID's delayed submission of procedures remains unclear.

description: City appoints Councillors Dubois and Ford as proxies.
Proxies will vote at Gallery Corporation special meeting.
Standing Policy Committee on Finance provided City Auditor updates.
